package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/mock"
	"go.temporal.io/sdk/testsuite"
)

// run carries out the plan with a stand-in for starci step: fail names the
// steps that "run and fail", and ran lists what was started.
func run(t *testing.T, context_ string, fail ...string) (Outcome, []string) {
	t.Helper()
	var s testsuite.WorkflowTestSuite
	env := s.NewTestWorkflowEnvironment()
	env.RegisterWorkflow(StarciRun)
	env.RegisterActivity(RunStep)
	var ran []string
	env.OnActivity(RunStep, mock.Anything, mock.Anything).Return(func(_ context.Context, job Job) (Result, error) {
		var a struct {
			Number int `json:"number"`
			Step   struct {
				Name string `json:"name"`
			} `json:"step"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(job.Step, &a); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
		ran = append(ran, a.Step.Name)
		status := "passed"
		for _, f := range fail {
			if f == a.Step.Name {
				status = "failed"
			}
		}
		return Result{Number: a.Number, Name: a.Step.Name, Status: status}, nil
	})
	env.ExecuteWorkflow(StarciRun, Input{Context: json.RawMessage(context_), CloneURL: "file:///repo"})
	if !env.IsWorkflowCompleted() {
		t.Fatal("the workflow did not complete")
	}
	if err := env.GetWorkflowError(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var out Outcome
	if err := env.GetWorkflowResult(&out); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return out, ran
}

func statuses(o Outcome) map[string]string {
	m := map[string]string{}
	for _, r := range o.Results {
		m[r.Name] = r.Status
	}
	return m
}

func TestAPassingRunRunsEveryStep(t *testing.T) {
	out, ran := run(t, `{"event":"push","ref":"main","sha":"abc"}`)
	if !out.OK {
		t.Fatalf("not ok: %+v", out)
	}
	if len(ran) != len(out.Results) || len(ran) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("ran %v, results %+v", ran, out.Results)
	}
	for _, r := range out.Results {
		if r.Status != "passed" {
			t.Errorf("%+v", r)
		}
	}
}

func TestAFailedStepIsAResultAndSkipsWhatNeedsIt(t *testing.T) {
	first := steps[0].Name
	out, _ := run(t, `{"event":"push","ref":"main","sha":"abc"}`, first)
	if out.OK {
		t.Fatal("a failed step still gave an ok run")
	}
	got := statuses(out)
	if got[first] != "failed" {
		t.Fatalf("%s = %q", first, got[first])
	}
	for _, s := range steps {
		for _, n := range s.Needs {
			if n == 0 && got[s.Name] != "skipped" {
				t.Errorf("%s needs %s and is %q", s.Name, first, got[s.Name])
			}
		}
	}
}

// stand-in: a script in place of starci, to test what RunStep makes of an
// exit status and a result.
func standIn(t *testing.T, script string) {
	t.Helper()
	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "starci")
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte("#!/bin/sh\n"+script), 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Setenv("STARCI", path)
}

func runStep(t *testing.T) (Result, error) {
	t.Helper()
	var s testsuite.WorkflowTestSuite
	env := s.NewTestActivityEnvironment()
	env.RegisterActivity(RunStep)
	v, err := env.ExecuteActivity(RunStep, Job{Step: json.RawMessage(`{"number":1,"step":{"name":"x"}}`), Context: json.RawMessage(`{}`), CloneURL: "file:///repo"})
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	var r Result
	if err := v.Get(&r); err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	return r, nil
}

func TestAStepThatRanAndFailedIsNotAnError(t *testing.T) {
	standIn(t, `cat >/dev/null; echo "a line" >&2; echo '{"number":1,"name":"x","status":"failed","detail":"exit 1"}'`)
	r, err := runStep(t)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if r.Status != "failed" || r.Detail != "exit 1" {
		t.Fatalf("%+v", r)
	}
}

func TestAStepStarciCouldNotRunIsAnError(t *testing.T) {
	standIn(t, `cat >/dev/null; echo "no docker" >&2; exit 1`)
	if r, err := runStep(t); err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("got %+v", r)
	}
}

func TestStarciGetsTheStepOnStdin(t *testing.T) {
	standIn(t, `cat > "$0.in"; echo '{"number":1,"name":"x","status":"passed"}'`)
	if _, err := runStep(t); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv("STARCI") + ".in")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var job Job
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &job); err != nil || job.CloneURL != "file:///repo" {
		t.Fatalf("%s: %v", data, err)
	}
}
